description: Source code for a Code Block extension in a rich text editor, implementing features like syntax highlighting, indentation, and paste handling within a ProseMirror/Tiptap environment.

classes.name: CodeBlock
classes.description: A Tiptap Node extension implementing a code block with syntax highlighting, indentation, and paste handling.

methods.name: exitOnTripleEnter
methods.description: Handles exiting the code block on triple Enter key press.

methods.name: indentOnEnter
methods.description: Handles indentation when pressing Enter inside a code block.

methods.name: getNewline
methods.description: Calculates the newline and indentation string based on current line.

methods.name: getSelectedLines
methods.description: Retrieves lines within the code block that are selected.

methods.name: parseIndentation
methods.description: Parses indentation attributes from a ProseMirror node.

methods.name: getLineAt
methods.description: Finds the line at a specific position.

methods.name: inRange
methods.description: Checks if a number is within a range.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Creates an indentation string based on options.

methods.name: compareCaretPosition
methods.description: Compares two caret positions for equality.

methods.name: detectCodeBlock
methods.description: Detects if pasted content is a code block and extracts language info.

methods.name: inferLanguage
methods.description: Infers programming language from a DOM element's class or attribute.

methods.name: createCodeblockId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID for code blocks.
